{"metadata":{"description":"QQ Bot text and image channel plugin for DeepSeek Harness","id":"gh:1333319964","install_available":true,"language":"TypeScript","name":"DeepSeek-harness-qqbot","slug":"sliverp/DeepSeek-harness-qqbot","topics":["cordis","deepseek","deepseek-harness","dsh-plugin","qqbot","typescript"]},"paragraphs":[{"id":"p1s1","text":"QQ Bot text and image channel plugin for DeepSeek Harness"},{"id":"p2s1","text":"# DeepSeek Harness QQBot"},{"id":"p3s1","text":"中文 | English"},{"id":"p4s1","text":"An out-of-tree DeepSeek Harness channel plugin that connects an official QQ Bot Gateway to persisten"},{"id":"p4s2","text":"epSeek Harness channel plugin that connects an official QQ Bot Gateway to persistent Harness agents."},{"id":"p5s1","text":"## Features"},{"id":"p6s1","text":"- Official `@tencent-connect/qqbot-nodejs` Gateway client
- C2C and group text messages
- Inbound PN"},{"id":"p6s2","text":"G, JPEG, WebP, and GIF images as durable Harness attachments
- Automatic text-only fallback when the"},{"id":"p6s3","text":" selected model does not accept image input
- Inbound voice transcripts and non-image attachment met"},{"id":"p6s4","text":"adata with the temporary QQ download URL
- Outbound assistant text, images, and local workspace file"},{"id":"p6s5","text":"s
- A QQ-turn-scoped `qq_send_file` tool with workspace containment and file-size checks
- QQ Markdo"},{"id":"p6s6","text":"wn replies, enabled by default
- One persistent Harness session per C2C or group conversation
- `/ne"},{"id":"p6s7","text":"w` and `/reset` retain old history and switch to a fresh durable session; other Harness slash comman"},{"id":"p6s8","text":"ds go directly to the command runtime
- Harness agent-preset composition for the same tools, prompts"},{"id":"p6s9","text":", and skills as Web sessions
- Safe reuse of a live session already opened by Web, without a second "},{"id":"p6s10","text":"session writer
- Proactive, requester-bound QQ approval prompts with one-shot Allow and Reject butto"},{"id":"p6s11","text":"ns
- Approval timeout rejection, fallback to another composed approval channel, and no escalation ca"},{"id":"p6s12","text":"rry-over to later tool calls
- Typing indicators, long-reply splitting, per-conversation ordering, d"},{"id":"p6s13","text":"uplicate suppression, send retries, and bounded timeouts
- Open, allowlist, or disabled access polic"},{"id":"p6s14","text":"ies for C2C and group traffic
- `/bot-ping`, `/bot-image-test`, `/bot-file-test`, `/bot-help`, `/bot"},{"id":"p6s15","text":"-status`, and `/bot-cancel`
- Secrets resolved through the Harness credential service instead of plu"},{"id":"p6s16","text":"gin configuration
- Dormant startup when AppID or AppSecret is not configured, so installation alone"},{"id":"p6s17","text":"
- Dormant startup when AppID or AppSecret is not configured, so installation alone never blocks DSH"},{"id":"p7s1","text":"## Requirements"},{"id":"p8s1","text":"- Node.js 22.19 or later
- pnpm 10.33.4
- DeepSeek Harness 0.1.0-rc.7 or later
- A QQ Bot AppID and "},{"id":"p8s2","text":"AppSecret with C2C and/or group message events enabled; Inline Keyboard permission is required for Q"},{"id":"p8s3","text":" and/or group message events enabled; Inline Keyboard permission is required for QQ approval buttons"},{"id":"p9s1","text":"## Install from GitHub"},{"id":"p10s1","text":"[代码示例省略，未执行]"},{"id":"p11s1","text":"For a local checkout:"},{"id":"p12s1","text":"[代码示例省略，未执行]"},{"id":"p13s1","text":"## Configure"},{"id":"p14s1","text":"Set the AppID in the launch environment and store the AppSecret under the credential reference `QQBO"},{"id":"p14s2","text":"T_APP_SECRET`. An environment value is supported for development:"},{"id":"p15s1","text":"[代码示例省略，未执行]"},{"id":"p16s1","text":"The bundle reads `QQBOT_APP_ID`, resolves `QQBOT_APP_SECRET` through `ctx.credentials`, and uses the"},{"id":"p16s2","text":" launch directory as the agent working directory. `DSH_QQBOT_CWD` can override the working directory"},{"id":"p16s3","text":"launch directory as the agent working directory. `DSH_QQBOT_CWD` can override the working directory."},{"id":"p17s1","text":"Installing the bundle does not require configuring credentials immediately. Configure both values and reload or restart DSH to connect. A non-empty but invalid cre"},{"id":"p17s4","text":"dential leaves only the QQ channel offline; authentication runs in the background and does not fail "},{"id":"p17s5","text":"es only the QQ channel offline; authentication runs in the background and does not fail DSH startup."},{"id":"p18s1","text":"For a durable setup, put `QQBOT_APP_ID` in `~/.dsh/.env` and store `QQBOT_APP_SECRET` with the Harne"},{"id":"p18s2","text":"ss credential settings surface.
